# 1. Generar la clave privada
openssl genrsa -out distribution.key 2048

# 2. Generar el CSR
openssl req -new -key distribution.key -out CertificateSigningRequest.certSigningRequest -subj "/emailAddress=info@iteratech.co/CN=IteraTech/C=CO"



openssl pkcs12 -export -out certificado.p12 -inkey llave_privada.key -in certificado.crt
openssl pkcs12 -export -out Certificates.p12 -inkey distribution.key -in distribution.pem

openssl rsa -noout -modulus -in distribution.key | openssl md5

openssl x509 -noout -modulus -in distribution.pem | openssl md5

# En PowerShell
[Convert]::ToBase64String([IO.File]::ReadAllBytes("Certificates.p12")) | Set-Clipboard
